title: One wrong-typed numeric option in an earlier-version config entry fails setup or every cycle, with no quarantine
claim: async_migrate_entry only stamps the version, and ThermalParameters.from_config / _tabled_values / _flow_curve_values and comfort_band.effective read numeric options raw (no coercion, or a bare float()), so of 1200 seeded single-option mutants of a healthy all-features entry stamped v1..v6, 54 make the coordinator constructor raise (setup fails) and 88 make both cycles raise UpdateFailed (every update fails) -- 142 permanent failures, 21 to 26 per version -- with nothing logged as a quarantined option and no reset.
mechanism: _tabled_values copies ~50 numeric options straight from the entry (`config.get(KEY, DEFAULT)`, no float()), with the comment 'Booleans are coerced because a config entry may carry a string' -- numbers are not; a string or null dhw_tank_volume then raises in dhw_tank_thermal_mass on every cycle ('can't multiply sequence by non-int of type float'). from_config's own float(config.get(CONF_MAX_TEMP ...)) and _flow_curve_values' float(config.get(CONF_TARGET_TEMP ...)) raise in the constructor on '', 'abc', None, a list or a dict; comfort_band.effective's float(candidate.get(...)) raises on every cycle for min_temperature. An entity slot holding a list/dict raises as an unhashable key in InputReader._begin on every cycle. Because the migration validates nothing, an entry written by an older release (or a hand-edited core.config_entries) with one such value never loads until the user edits the option.

evidence.unit: mutants (of 1200 over v1..v6) whose setup or every cycle fails
evidence.contention_note: fan-out, run as two shards beside this seat's other harnesses; a count

perturbation.change: --fix: async_migrate_entry additionally drops every option whose JSON type differs from the type the config flow writes for it (the healthy record's), so the reader falls back to its default; patched in memory

metric_definition: Seeded single-option mutants of a healthy entry at vN whose constructor raises or whose two cycles both raise, summed over v1..v6.
phenomenon_property: A config-entry option of the wrong type or an empty value is coerced or reset to its default (and named once) at the entry's migration/parse boundary; no option value can make setup or every cycle fail.
seam_rule: grep -nE 'float\((config|candidate)\.get\(|config\.get\(\s*$' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/thermal_model.py custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/comfort_band.py  (plus the numeric rows of ThermalParameters._tabled_values' table)

null_control.note: the healthy entry at every version v1..v6 (the CTRL lines): migrate ok, construct ok, both cycles ok

proposed_fix_scope: Coerce numeric options once (EntryConfig or _tabled_values: finite_float with the default), drop/repair a wrong-typed option at async_migrate_entry with one log line; entity slots accept only str.
